blocks.text:
The next 4 days have no scheduled transfers or excursions.

At Nannai Muro Alto, you can head to the beach in the morning, wait for low tide and swim behind the reef. Strong waves are rare here, the water is warm, and you can see the pale seabed clearly even farther from shore.

For a change of scene, trips on **jangadas**, the local flat rafts, to the natural pools are available in the resort centre. At low tide, pools of clear water remain between the reefs, where you can watch small fish through a snorkelling mask.

Diving and buggy rides along the coast are also available.

You can also spend these days without extra trips: relax by the pool, walk along Muro Alto and return to the sea in the morning and evening when the sand is cooler. After the busy programme in Rio, Iguazu and Bonito, this part of the trip gives you a few quiet days without constantly changing hotels.
